en.headline: HKEX cuts minimum tick size for mid-priced stocks from today
en.dek: Phase 2 of the minimum spreads reduction takes effect, halving the tick size for equities and other securities priced between HK$0.50 and HK$10.
body: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited implemented the second phase of its minimum spreads reduction on Monday, lowering the minimum price movement for applicable securities priced between HK$0.50 and HK$10 from HK$0.01 to HK$0.005.

The change covers equities, real estate investment trusts, equity warrants and other applicable securities, but excludes exchange-traded products, debt securities, exchange-traded options and structured products. The same 50 per cent reduction applies across currency denominations including the Hong Kong dollar and renminbi.

HKEX said the move aims to lower trading costs, improve price discovery and execution efficiency, and enhance the competitiveness of the Hong Kong market. Phase 1, which reduced spreads for higher-priced stocks, took effect on 4 August 2025.

The exchange had conducted market rehearsals and post-release tests ahead of the launch. Updated spread tables and operational guidance were issued to exchange participants in the weeks leading up to the change.

zh.headline: 港交所今日起下調中價股最低上落價位
zh.dek: 最低上落價位下調第二階段今日生效，介乎0.5元至10元的股票及其他適用證券最低上落價位減半至0.005元。
body: 香港交易及結算所有限公司今日（周一）實施最低上落價位下調第二階段，介乎0.5元至10元的適用證券最低上落價位由0.01元下調至0.005元。
措施涵蓋股票、房地產投資信託基金、股票權證及其他適用證券，但不包括交易所買賣產品、債務證券、股票期權及結構性產品。同一50%減幅適用於包括港元及人民幣在內的不同貨幣計價證券。
港交所指，措施旨在降低交易成本、改善價格發現及執行效率，並提升香港市場競爭力。第一階段針對較高價股票的下調已於2025年8月4日生效。
港交所在推出前已進行市場演練及推出後測試，並於過去數周向交易所參與者發出更新的上落價位表及操作指引。
